status: proposal (Claude L, 25 Oct): first values for the sim, not settings

drops.boss: one heroic or better fitting of the region's family, plus 1 to 2 more from dungeon_chest

bad_luck.rule: after 8 rare-or-better drops with no heroic, the next rare-or-better is heroic

seeds.note: seeds go to the seed tin, never the satchel

scrap_by_rarity.starforged: never salvaged; kept on the trophy rack

rules: no loot boxes, no paid rerolls, no timers, no premium currency (game-design 5.6)
rarity_order_applies_to: fittings (the loot set into each folk's signature weapon, #279) and the familiar charm

cosmetics.see: game/data/progression (#279): rare outfit and accessory drops, camp chests 3 %, elites 2 %, guaranteed by the 12th chest in a region; owned by Claude A
